# PolicySources

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/onnx/policy_systems.h`](../../../src/onnx/policy_systems.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

Host context variable written by ModelWatcher: what policy each world runs, for panels and overlays.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `worlds` | `std::vector<PolicySource>` | one per world: `spec` (the model parameter), `file` (the loaded checkpoint, empty before the first load), `step` (from <behavior>-<step>.onnx, -1 without), `error` |

## Notes

Emplaced by ModelWatcher's constructor, filled at its first tick, updated at every load; read by SphereView.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: SphereView. Written by: ModelWatcher. Created by: ModelWatcher. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | constructor | emplaced empty in the host registry |
| [ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick (first, load) | one PolicySource per world: spec, loaded file, step, error |
| [SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | policy file, step or error of the world (built with DYNAMICAL_ONNX) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md)**
  - Reads the file system: lists <dir> (or the directories matching a '*' component) for <behavior>-<step>.onnx every `poll` seconds of wall clock; a new checkpoint is loaded once two polls see the same size and write time.
  - Creates ONNX Runtime sessions (PolicyRunner, or AgentPolicy through a process-wide cache keyed by path and write time).
  - Logs info on every load, a warning when a folder has no checkpoint, an error when a model is refused.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
